meta.note: Gas fleet capacity factor and stacked FOM cost (net of capacity payments) by CFE threshold, all 7 ISOs, 4 pathways, 5 endpoints. Gas fleet CF = gas_gen_twh / (full_existing_fleet_gw × 8.76). Uses full existing fleet as denominator to show fleet-level underutilization. FOM computed on gas_remaining_gw (after endogenous retirement). Reliability tax = net FOM per MWh of total demand.
meta.gas_cf_definition: gas_fleet_cf = (demand_2050 × (1 − achieved_cfe%)) / (EXISTING_GAS_GW × 8.76). Numerator = annual gas generation implied by CFE gap. Denominator = maximum possible generation from full existing fleet at CF=100%.
meta.fom_definition: gas_fom_annual = gas_remaining_gw × EXISTING_GAS_FOM_KW_YR × 1000. net_fom = gas_fom_annual − capacity_rev_netted_usd (from annual_cost[2050]). reliability_tax = net_fom / (demand_2050_twh × 1e6) in $/MWh.
